"""Static Phase 5A design checks only. No application imports or execution."""
import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path.cwd()
M = ROOT / 'data/evaluation/generation/phase5/phase5a_ablation_manifest_v0.json'
m = json.loads(M.read_text())
def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(message)
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def canonical(obj):
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
def chash(obj):
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical(obj)).hexdigest()
def read(rel):
    return json.loads((ROOT / rel).read_text())
def rows(rel):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in (ROOT / rel).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
def diff(a, b, prefix=''):
    if type(a) is not type(b):
        return [prefix]
    if isinstance(a, dict):
        out = []
        for k in sorted(set(a) | set(b)):
            p = prefix + '.' + k if prefix else k
            if k not in a or k not in b:
                out.append(p)
            else:
                out.extend(diff(a[k], b[k], p))
        return out
    return [] if a == b else [prefix]

def check_config(key, candidate):
    ref = m['variant_manifests']['R2']
    expected = m['config_diff_validation']['expected_difference_paths'][key]
    require(candidate['variant_id'] == m['variant_manifests'][key]['variant_id'], 'variant ID drift')
    require([p for p in diff(ref, candidate) if p != 'variant_id'] == expected, 'unexpected config diff')
    for p in expected:
        flag = p.split('.')[1]
        require(ref['ablation_flags'][flag] is True and candidate['ablation_flags'][flag] is False, 'unexpected flag values/types')

require(m['phase'] == '5A' and m['status'] == 'FROZEN' and m['execution_started'] is False, 'scope')
require(m['primary_ids'] == ['R2', 'A1', 'A2'], 'primary IDs')
require(m['execution_protocol']['production_order'] == ['R2', 'A1', 'A2'], 'order')
require(sha(ROOT / m['specification']['path']) == m['specification']['sha256'], 'spec hash')
for key, v in m['variant_manifests'].items():
    require(chash(v) == m['variant_manifest_canonical_sha256'][key], 'variant hash ' + key)
    if key != 'R2':
        check_config(key, v)
negative_controls = []
mutations = {
    'top_k': lambda x: x.update(top_k=6),
    'prompt_hash': lambda x: x.update(prompt_hash='0'*64),
    'budget': lambda x: x.update(max_llm_calls=7),
    'bool_vs_integer': lambda x: x['ablation_flags'].update(enable_expansion=1),
    'extra_key': lambda x: x.update(extra_behavior=True),
    'missing_key': lambda x: x.pop('dense_revision'),
    'noop_ablation': lambda x: x['ablation_flags'].update(enable_answer_revision=True),
    'wrong_second_capability': lambda x: x['ablation_flags'].update(enable_citation_revision=False),
    'timestamp': lambda x: x.update(created_at='changed'),
}
for name, mutate in mutations.items():
    candidate = copy.deepcopy(m['variant_manifests']['A1'])
    mutate(candidate)
    try:
        check_config('A1', candidate)
    except AssertionError:
        negative_controls.append(name)
    else:
        raise AssertionError('negative control accepted: '+name)
print('PASS exact config diffs R2/A1, R2/A2, optional A3/A4;',len(negative_controls),'negative controls rejected')

before = m['source_integrity']['before_sha256']
require(chash(before) == m['source_integrity']['before_inventory_canonical_sha256'], 'inventory hash')
current = {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p) for p in sorted(ROOT.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and not any(x in p.relative_to(ROOT).parts for x in ('.venv', '.git', '.env'))}
require(len(before) == 246, 'source count')
require(all(current.get(p) == h for p,h in before.items()), 'original file modified/deleted')
require(set(current)-set(before) == set(m['source_integrity']['new_repository_paths']), 'unexpected new path')
for a in m['frozen_artifacts']:
    require(sha(ROOT/a['path']) == a['sha256'], 'frozen artifact hash '+a['path'])
print('PASS original 246 files unchanged; exactly two design files added; 67 named frozen artifact hashes match')

base = 'data/evaluation/generation/'
r0manifest = read(base+'standard_rag_manifest_v0.json')
r1manifest = read(base+'agentic_rag_metrics_v1_agentic-v1.json')['manifest']
field_paths = {
    'generation_verified_sha256': base+'generation_eval_v1_verified.json',
    'retrieval_eval_sha256': 'data/evaluation/retrieval_eval.jsonl',
    'corpus_chunks_sha256': 'data/versions/corpus-v0.1/chunks.jsonl',
}
for field,path in field_paths.items():
    require(before[path] == r0manifest['dataset_hashes'][field] == r1manifest['dataset_hashes'][field], 'historical hash '+field)
require(before[base+'generation_eval_v1_verified_manifest.json'] == r0manifest['dataset_hashes']['generation_verified_manifest_sha256'], 'verified manifest historical hash')
require(before['prompts/legal_rag_v0.txt'] == r0manifest['prompt_sha256'] == r1manifest['dataset_hashes']['prompt_sha256'], 'prompt historical hash')
require(before[base+'standard_rag_eval_v0.jsonl'] == r0manifest['dataset_hashes']['result_dataset_sha256'], 'R0 results historical hash')
require(before[base+'agentic_rag_eval_v1_agentic-v1.jsonl'] == r1manifest['dataset_hashes']['results_sha256'], 'R1 results historical hash')
require(before[base+'standard_rag_metrics_v0.json'] == r1manifest['dataset_hashes']['standard_rag_metrics_sha256'], 'R0 metrics historical hash')
phase4 = read(base+'agentic_trace_analysis_metrics_v0.json')['source_integrity']['hashes']
require(len(phase4) == 113 and all(before.get(p) == v['after_sha256'] for p,v in phase4.items()), 'Phase4E provenance')
print('PASS R0/R1 embedded historical hashes and all 113 Phase4E provenance hashes')

dataset = read(base+'generation_eval_v1_verified.json')
items = dataset['items']
require(dataset['dataset_status']=='verified' and dataset['evaluation_version']=='generation-eval-v1', 'dataset status/version')
require(len(items) == len({i['query_id'] for i in items}) == 31, 'query count/uniqueness')
require([i['query_id'] for i in items] == m['query_order'], 'query order')
require(sum(len(i['required_points']) for i in items) == 102, 'point count')
require(len({(i['query_id'], p['point_id']) for i in items for p in i['required_points']}) == 102, 'point uniqueness')
projection = [{'query_id': i['query_id'], 'query': i['query']} for i in items]
require(chash(projection) == m['query_input_schema']['canonical_sha256'], 'projection hash')
require(all(hashlib.sha256(i['query'].encode()).hexdigest() == m['query_text_sha256_by_id'][i['query_id']] for i in items), 'query hash')
require(all(i['query']==i['query'].strip() and i['annotation_status']=='verified' for i in items), 'query whitespace/verification')
expected_queries = {i['query_id']: i['query'] for i in items}
for name in ['standard_rag_eval_v0.jsonl', 'agentic_rag_eval_v1_agentic-v1.jsonl']:
    rs = rows(base+name)
    require(len(rs)==31 and {r['query_id']:r['query'] for r in rs} == expected_queries, 'historical query mapping')
    if name.startswith('agentic'):
        for r in rs:
            require(r['trace'] == read('data/rag/traces/agentic-rag-v1/agentic-v1/'+r['query_id']+'.json'), 'disk/embedded trace mismatch')
require({r['query_id']:r['query'] for r in rows('data/evaluation/retrieval_eval.jsonl')} == expected_queries, 'retrieval query mapping')
print('PASS 31 verified query identities, 102 query/point tuples, projection hashes, 31 R1 disk/embedded traces')

runtime_ast = ast.parse((ROOT/'scripts/agentic_rag.py').read_text())
constants = {n.targets[0].id: ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in runtime_ast.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and isinstance(n.targets[0],ast.Name) and n.targets[0].id.startswith('MAX_')}
expected_constants = {'MAX_SUB_QUERIES':3,'MAX_RETRIEVAL_EXPANSIONS':1,'MAX_ANSWER_REVISIONS':1,'MAX_CITATION_REVISIONS':1,'MAX_LLM_CALLS':6}
require(constants == expected_constants, 'controller constants')
cls = next(n for n in runtime_ast.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name=='AgenticRAGController')
init = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='__init__')
require([a.arg for a in init.args.kwonlyargs] == ['enable_expansion','enable_answer_revision','enable_citation_revision'], 'constructor flags')
require(all(ast.literal_eval(v) is True for v in init.args.kw_defaults), 'flag defaults')
run = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='run')
branch_conditions = [ast.unparse(n.test) for n in ast.walk(run) if isinstance(n,ast.If)]
require(any('self.enable_expansion' in s and 'state.missing_aspects' in s for s in branch_conditions), 'expansion guard')
require(any('self.enable_answer_revision' in s and 'MAX_ANSWER_REVISIONS' in s for s in branch_conditions), 'answer guard')
require(any('self.enable_citation_revision' in s and 'MAX_CITATION_REVISIONS' in s for s in branch_conditions), 'citation guard')
modules = set()
queue = ['agentic_rag']
forbidden = ['generation_eval_v1_verified', 'retrieval_eval.jsonl', 'required_point_ids', 'gold_chunk_ids', 'failure_analysis_', 'agentic_trace_analysis_']
while queue:
    name = queue.pop()
    if name in modules:
        continue
    modules.add(name)
    path = ROOT/'scripts'/(name+'.py')
    source = path.read_text()
    require(not name.startswith(('evaluate_', 'validate_generation_eval')), 'evaluator import in production')
    require(all(s not in source for s in forbidden), 'leakage source marker in '+name)
    for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(source)):
        imports = [n.module] if isinstance(n,ast.ImportFrom) else [a.name for a in n.names] if isinstance(n,ast.Import) else []
        for module in imports:
            if module and (ROOT/'scripts'/(module.split('.')[0]+'.py')).exists():
                queue.append(module.split('.')[0])
require(sorted('scripts/'+n+'.py' for n in modules)==m['leakage_protection']['static_checked_modules'], 'import closure inventory')
print('PASS frozen AST budgets/flags/branch guards; 10-module production import closure has no evaluator/gold markers')

b = m['analysis_plan']['bootstrap']
require((b['seed'], b['resamples'], b['sample_size']) == (20260906,10000,31), 'bootstrap plan')
require(not b['executed_in_phase5a'], 'bootstrap must not execute')
require(all(m['validation'][k] == 0 for k in ['network_calls','gemini_api_calls','new_retrieval_calls','new_generation','new_evaluation']), 'execution scope counters')
require(not m['leakage_protection']['dynamic_tests_executed_in_phase5a'], 'dynamic tests misreported')
require(m['runtime_mechanism']['status']=='DESIGNED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED', 'implementation scope')
print('Phase 5A static validation: PASS. No application modules imported or runtime/evaluator calls executed.')
